description: TY2026: single kiddie-tax child (SS 1(g)), $25,000 wages, $4,000 AOTC expenses. SS 25A(i) last sentence: the 40% refundable treatment 'shall not apply... if such taxpayer is a child to whom subsection (g) of section 1 applies' -> refundable portion $0; the whole 2,500 is nonrefundable but limited to tax. The SS 1(g) override also fires (all wages, no unearned income -> NUI 0 -> Form 8615 tax = regular tax): TI = 8,900 -> Table midpoint 8,925 -> 10% -> $893. Education nonrefundable = min(2,500, 893) = 893 -> tax after credits $0. Childless EITC: $25,000 is past the completed 2026 phase-out -> $0. Net $0.00.
